## What and why

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (no API change)
- [ ] New feature (adds a prop, option, or component)
- [ ] Breaking change (alters or removes existing API)
- [ ] Docs / types / build only

## Checks

- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npx tsc -b` is clean
- [ ] `npm run lint` reports no errors
- [ ] Touched components keep their keyboard and screen-reader behaviour
- [ ] New or changed props are reflected in the component's `.schema.json`
      (the `.ai.md` prop table is generated from it — see CONTRIBUTING)
- [ ] Renders correctly in both light and dark themes
